items.title: SonicWall Edge Access Devices Hit by Zero-Day Attacks
items.description: In the latest attacks against the vendor's SMA1000 devices, threat actors have chained a new zero-day flaw with a critical vulnerability disclosed earlier this year.

items.title: University of Sydney suffers data breach exposing student and staff info
items.description: Hackers gained access to an online coding repository belonging to the University of Sydney and stole files with personal information of staff and students. [...]
